title.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: landscape title-screen key art for Helix Heresy, no text. Primary request: a respectable ordinary above-ground chemistry laboratory conceals a forbidden underground magitech research facility. Composition: wide 16:9 architectural cutaway illustration, upper third the modest chemistry laboratory with benches, glassware, loading entrance and daylight; below a physical cutaway through charcoal bedrock reveals a larger secret research chamber with glass synthesis vessels holding simple green slime, pipes, workbench, and restrained holographic instrument light. No people required. Hard-edged illustrated shapes, controlled low-detail industrial materials, cool gray stone and steel, warm brass and amber lamps, green biology and cyan arcane accents. Dramatic readable silhouettes and depth without busy microdetail. Center of the composition can be subdued because the opaque menu card overlays it; the secret chamber and surface lab should still read toward the sides. This is title illustration, not a map screenshot. No gods, churches, military armies, new beast species, gore or sexual imagery. No words, title lettering, logos, labels, UI controls or watermark. Full opaque finished background.
